# ui::TextStyle

Header: `winui/render/Text.hpp`.

Everything a [Renderer](renderer.md) and [TextMeasurer](text-measurer.md) need to know about how a run of text looks: font, size, weight, alignment inside its box, wrapping, decorations and spacing.

A plain aggregate, filled in with designated initializers. Controls normally take their style from the theme's type ramp (see [TextRole](namespace-ui.md#textrole)); passing one explicitly ([`TextControl::set_text_style()`](../controls/text.md#set_text_style), [`ui::Text::style`](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec)) pins it. Sizes are in DIPs.

Example: 
```cpp
const ui::TextStyle heading{
    .font_size   = 20.0f,
    .horizontal  = ui::TextAlign::Leading,
    .font_family = "Segoe UI Variable",
    .weight      = ui::FontWeight::SemiBold,
    .wrapping    = ui::TextWrapping::WrapWholeWords,
};

auto label = std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Account");
label->set_text_style(heading); // wins over the theme's role ramp from now on

// Or in a spec:
ui::Text{.text = "Account", .text_style = heading};
```

## font_size

```cpp
float font_size = 14.0f
```

Font size in DIPs (not points). Default 14.

## horizontal

```cpp
TextAlign horizontal = TextAlign::Center
```

Horizontal placement inside the drawing box; Center by default.

## vertical

```cpp
TextAlign vertical = TextAlign::Center
```

Vertical placement inside the drawing box; Center by default.

## font_family

```cpp
FontName font_family = "Segoe UI"
```

Font family name, looked up among the installed fonts.

## weight

```cpp
FontWeight weight = FontWeight::Regular
```

Font weight.

## italic

```cpp
bool italic = false
```

Italic face.

## line_height

```cpp
float line_height = 0.0f
```

Puts every line in a line box of this height in DIPs, whatever the font's natural metrics, as the Metro theme does (20 DIPs for body text, 40 for the 56px header). 0, the default, uses the font's natural line height.

## effect

```cpp
TextEffect effect {}
```

Defaults to no effect (a single plain pass); see [TextEffect](text-effect.md).

## wrapping

```cpp
TextWrapping wrapping = TextWrapping::NoWrap
```

NoWrap (the default) keeps every run on one line, whatever box it is drawn into. A wrapping style is measured with [TextMeasurer::measure_wrapped()](text-measurer.md#measure_wrapped) against the width it will be drawn in, and a renderer breaks its lines at that box's width.

## underline

```cpp
bool underline = false
```

A line under the run, at the font's own underline position and thickness. Never changes the measured size.

## strikethrough

```cpp
bool strikethrough = false
```

A line through the run, likewise.

## character_spacing

```cpp
int character_spacing = 0
```

Extra room after every character, in thousandths of an em (200 at 24px adds 4.8 DIPs a character). Negative values tighten. It is part of the run's advance, so it widens the measured size, the last character's included.

## character_spacing_dips

```cpp
float character_spacing_dips() const
```

[`character_spacing`](#character_spacing) converted to DIPs per character at this style's [`font_size`](#font_size).
